name: 5G Core & IMS E2E Call Flow Correlator
description: Multi-protocol network analyzer for 3GPP 5G Core and IMS environments. Upload PCAP traces, correlate signaling, and visualize interactive call flow diagrams with IMSI/MSISDN tracking. Supports VoNR, VoLTE, and 5G SA troubleshooting.
